description: Authoritative capability manifest for AIBA. Every registered tool MUST have an entry here before it can be enabled in config/permissions.json. Optional per-tool fields: feature_flag, optional_dependency (or 'needs:<executable>'), internal_only (bool, default false) to mark a tool as registered purely for internal use so it is never advertised to the model. See docs/PLAN_v1.6_capability_parity.md.

risk_classes.read_only_local: Read or inspect local workspace data; no mutation. Approval not required.
risk_classes.read_only_network: Read-only public network access; strictly SSRF-safe against private/loopback/credential targets. Approval not required.
risk_classes.local_mutation: Writes, edits, archives, or otherwise mutates data inside the AIBA workspace. Approval required.
risk_classes.external_mutation: Causes a change on an external system (send, post, submit, purchase, authenticate). Approval required.
risk_classes.process_execution: Starts processes, runs shell/code, or sends process input. Approval required.
risk_classes.destructive: Deletes, terminates, or irreversibly destroys data or processes. Approval required.

feature_flags.AIBA_WEB_ENABLED: Gates the web_search / web_extract tools (read-only network).
feature_flags.AIBA_BROWSER_ENABLED: Gates browser tooling (browser_fetch today). Requires installed browser dependencies.
feature_flags.AIBA_DESKTOP_ENABLED: Gates computer-control tooling (desktop_screenshot / desktop_click / desktop_type). Disabled until the paired-node security phase is complete.
feature_flags.AIBA_VISION_ENABLED: Gates vision_analyze; requires a vision-capable model.
feature_flags.none: No feature flag required (always available once enabled).

patch_file.description: Apply a find-and-replace edit to a workspace text file, atomically, returning the diff.

archive.description: Create a zip or tarball of a workspace path, written inside the workspace.

extract_archive.description: Extract a zip/tar archive into a workspace destination, blocking zip-slip.

web_search.description: Search the public web for a topic and return title/url/snippet results.

web_extract.description: Fetch readable text from one or more PUBLIC http(s) pages; SSRF-safe.

skill_instructions.description: Read a reviewed portable skill instruction contract.

clarify.description: Ask the user one focused question with choices and tradeoffs.
